messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-3.2.7 is released and on pypi.
messages.subject_clean: [Rpy] rpy2-3.2.7 is released and on pypi.
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

rpy2-3.2.7 is released and on pypi. This is solely fixing a compatibility
issue with Python 3.5.
The next release will normally be rpy2-3.3.0, and should happen quite soon.

Best,

Laurent
